latestRun.verification: GitHub/source-math only; no Unity runtime was available. Source audit confirmed WornPathB is a 2.0 x 6.0 m rectangular Cube at y-top 0.045 m, about 0.53 m east of the continuous ParkPathEast curb. The correction disables only its Renderer, preserves the gameplay collider, removes complete curb modules 26/27 to create an approximately 1.212 m opening, and creates four authored curved/tapered soil LOD meshes with world-metre UV0. Self-audit rejected the first spline: P1=12.15 plus early width expansion produced 11 inverted source-math triangles. The corrected spline uses P1=12.45 and holds the 1.05 m mouth width through t=0.22 before expansion. Independent source math then measured minimum triangle-normal Y of 0.78795/0.80034/0.85094/0.85920 for LOD0-3, vertex counts 343/203/85/45, maximum LOD bounds-center drift about 0.001421 m and size drift about 0.002842 m. Mouth z=4.875-5.925 m remains inside the curb opening z=4.794-6.006 m with about 81 mm end clearance. These are not Unity/runtime/render observations.
